en: Black-and-white illustrated postcard showing the interior of a rustic, wood‑paneled farmhouse room with shelves holding jugs, plates, and decorative items, a bench, and potted plants. Beneath the illustration is a block of stylized German text inviting people to view the newly built farmer's room at an address on Münsterplatz, followed by a note about a permanent folk‑art exhibition and a small artist signature.
